name: estonia-public-procurement-2024
title: Estonia Public Procurement Contracts 2024
description: Awarded public procurement contracts in Estonia during calendar year 2024 that disclose a contract value, sourced from the Estonian Public Procurement Register (riigihanked.riik.ee) and cross-referenced with the Estonian Business Register (äriregister). One row per awarded supplier. Published as a Frictionless Fiscal Data Package by Nimistu MTÜ.

fields.name: notice_id
fields.title: Notice ID
fields.description: Stable contract-folder identifier (UUID) from the procurement register.

fields.name: buyer_reg_code
fields.title: Buyer registry code
fields.description: Estonian registry code of the contracting authority.

fields.name: winner_reg_code
fields.title: Supplier registry code
fields.description: Registry code of the awarded supplier (Estonian or foreign).

fields.name: winner_in_ariregister
fields.title: Supplier in äriregister
fields.description: Whether the supplier was matched to a current entry in the Estonian Business Register.

fields.name: winner_status
fields.title: Supplier status
fields.description: Current äriregister status of the supplier when matched (e.g. registris).

fields.name: cpv_all
fields.title: CPV (all)
fields.description: All CPV codes for the procurement, semicolon-separated.

fields.name: contract_end_date
fields.title: Contract end date
fields.description: Planned contract end date, when published.

fields.name: source_url
fields.title: Source URL
fields.description: Link to the procurement in riigihanked.riik.ee.
